messages:
Aisha: Hey team — need a short customer-facing runbook for BetaCorp onboarding. They hit sporadic latency spikes and are getting anxious about renewal risk. Can we pull together a 1-page checklist they can share with their engineers?

Tom S: 1-pager sounds good. Keep it scannable: quick health checks, config snippets, and an escalation section.

Aisha: Exactly. Suggest sections: 1) immediate health check (3 quick probes) 2) runtime config (client-side queueing + concurrency) 3) streaming fallback for UX 4) caching TTLs + examples 5) when to escalate to CS/Eng 6) renewal touchpoints.

Jorge: Draft notes from infra side:
- client max_concurrency: 4 (start)
- client queue depth: 8 (drop older low-priority requests)
- backoff: exponential with jitter (base 200ms, max 5s)
- batching: target 4-8 requests to balance tokens vs latency
- streaming: prefer SSE/websockets when p95 > ~1s so UX receives partial tokens
- cache: prefix-cache for repeated prompts, TTL 10–30m depending on volatility

Jorge: Example curl for streaming fallback:```
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" 
  -H "X-Client-Max-Concurrency: 4" 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

Tom S: Add a short checklist for the health check: 1) run `curl /models` to confirm variant and version 2) confirm avg token-per-request 3) check client-side concurrency metrics (running >4?)

Tom S: Escalation triggers (suggested): repeated 5% error rate over 10m, sustained p95 latency >2s for core flows, sudden token spend >2x expected week-over-week.

Priya K: For renewal/pulse: Day 3 check-in (confirm instrumentation + streaming enabled), Day 10 usage review, Day 14 run a mini-load test with support, offer 1-hr enablement session + share runbook. Capture feedback via this short form: https://forms.redwood.com/onboard-feedback

Aisha: Nice. Can we make the language non-technical where possible so their product managers can read it too?

Jorge: Will add tiny callouts explaining terms (batching, TTL, streaming).

doc-bot: doc-bot uploaded draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/runbooks/beta-mini-runbook (internal) — please review and comment.

Tom S: :thumbsup: I'll paste this into the CS playbook and tag BetaCorp in the activity.

Aisha: Thanks all — I'll do a quick polish and send to BetaCorp tomorrow AM. @Priya K can you take Day 3 outreach?

Priya K: Yes, I'll schedule it. :white_check_mark:
